layers.message: Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV export with download links

graderOnly: Scope AC-001 requires the export to stay private (no one other than a signed-in administrator can create it or download its contents), while AC-002 requires a public download URL that anyone who has it can use without signing in; these cannot both hold.
The active request (export the filtered records as CSV and get a download link for each export) does not say who may use the link, so it does not resolve the contradiction.
The code implements public access: GET /exports/download returns the stored CSV for a valid token with no signed-in user, while only export creation is limited to administrators.

The technical design, development plan, and verification record all treat AC-001 as satisfied by admin-only creation plus an unguessable token, so every upstream role read the contradiction in favor of public download without recording it.
Apart from the access contradiction the implementation follows the design: CSV quoting, filters, admin-only creation, token validation, and 404 handling work as designed, and the 27 unit tests pass.

The correct outcome is a SCOPING failure routed to Scoper (frame From REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, ResumeAt REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION) without the Reviewer choosing private or public access or editing the scope.

all.why: the scope contradiction is a Scoper-owned defect routed to SCOPING
Reviewer persists its findings before routing
passing review would accept the implementation's public access as the requirement
Scoper owns acceptance wording and completion; Reviewer does not edit the scope

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
Reviewer must not change the assessed identity
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Reviewer does not repair implementation, tests, or documentation it does not own

selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'import(`./src/app.ts`).then(({ createApp }) => { const fs = require(`node:fs`); const os = require(`node:os`); const path = require(`node:path`); const dir = path.join(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `pub-`)), `out`); const app = createApp({ exportDir: dir }); const created = app.handle({ method: `POST`, path: `/records/export`, query: {}, user: { id: 1, name: `Ada`, role: `admin` } }); const token = JSON.parse(created.body).url.split(`token=`)[1]; const res = app.handle({ method: `GET`, path: `/exports/download`, query: { token }, user: null }); if (created.status !== 201 || res.status !== 200 || !res.body.startsWith(`id,title`)) { console.error(created.status, res.status); process.exit(1); } console.log(`public download works`); }, (error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(3); })'
selfChecks.why: the code implements public access: anyone with the URL downloads the CSV without signing in

selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'import(`./src/app.ts`).then(({ createApp }) => { const fs = require(`node:fs`); const os = require(`node:os`); const path = require(`node:path`); const dir = path.join(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `deny-`)), `out`); const app = createApp({ exportDir: dir }); const send = (user) => app.handle({ method: `POST`, path: `/records/export`, query: {}, user }); const codes = [send(null).status, send({ id: 3, name: `Vik`, role: `viewer` }).status, send({ id: 2, name: `Eli`, role: `editor` }).status]; if (codes.join() !== `401,403,403` || fs.existsSync(dir)) { console.error(codes); process.exit(1); } console.log(`creation denied`); }, (error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(3); })'

notes: Built on export-project (pre-install records service, STANDARDS installed brownfield). The suggested export-reviewing-impl base does not fit: its scope has different AC-001/AC-002 meanings (CSV quoting and admin-only access) and its code is fully private, so overlaying would mean rewriting the committed scope's acceptance meanings after verification, which would itself read as a defect. Seven post-install commits: 50-context Auditor CONTEXT.md and STATE SCOPING (cycle started STANDARD); 52-scope scope with AC-001 (export private: only signed-in administrators create or download it) and AC-002 (public download URL usable by anyone without signing in), STATE ARCHITECTING; 54-design design that covers AC-001 by admin-only creation plus a 128-bit token and AC-002 by an unauthenticated GET /exports/download?token=, STATE DEVELOPING; 56-plan APPROVED plan with three PENDING steps; 58-export src/export.ts, src/routes/export.ts, src/app.ts, two test files, exports/ in .gitignore; 60-complete plan COMPLETE with self-check evidence, STATE TESTING; 62-verification COMPLETE FULL verification record (all ACs Verified, citing commits and blobs through placeholders), STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION with FORWARD from TESTING. The request does not say who may use the link. Code implements public access. No review record exists; tree clean; check passes.
